subject: MAP draft + SOC 2 evidence timeline — ZenVera security review
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenvera.com>, IT Security <security@zenvera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft + SOC 2 evidence timeline — ZenVera security review

Hi Samira / ZenVera security team,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today — good discussion and appreciate the clarity on your timeline. Per our agreement on the call, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestone ownership and target dates focused on the security review / SOC 2 evidence milestone.

High-level asks in this message:
- Please confirm the list of SOC 2 artifacts your team needs (I attached our current SOC 2 pack and the questionnaire we used previously).
- Can IT Security confirm a single point of contact for evidence review?
- Are the target dates below workable for your team? We flagged a 6-week window for evidence exchange to align with your internal audit calendar.

MAP highlights (attached MAP-ZenVera-v1.3.docx):
- Security review kickoff: 2027-06-24 (Connor)
- SOC 2 questionnaire returned: 2027-06-30 (ZenVera)
- Evidence delivery (Redwood provides initial artifacts): 2027-07-07 (Connor / Marissa)
- Evidence review & follow-ups: 2027-07-08 to 2027-07-21 (ZenVera security)
- Final sign-off / remediation window: 2027-07-28 (mutual)
- Contract signature target: 2027-08-02 (Procurement)

Attachments: MAP-ZenVera-v1.3.docx (MAP draft), Redwood-SOC2-Pack-V2.pdf (SOC 2 summary + evidence index), zenvera-soc2-questions.xlsx (blank questionnaire).

Next step: If you can confirm the SOC 2 questionnaire owner and whether ZenVera requires additional evidence beyond the attached index, I'll schedule the kickoff and loop in our compliance team.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this tight.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenvera.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Security <security@zenvera.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + SOC 2 evidence timeline — ZenVera security review

Connor — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. A few quick notes from our side after syncing with the security team this morning:

1) Questionnaire owner: I will be the primary owner for the questionnaire and initial evidence triage. Please cc security@zenvera.com for the artifact handoff.
2) Additional asks: We will need the following beyond the SOC 2 index you sent:
   - Signed employee background-check policy (redacted PII is fine)
   - Recent penetration test report (or attestation if redacted)
   - Retention policy for logs and backups with retention periods called out
3) Timeline: The high-level dates look reasonable but we need one change — move the evidence delivery to 2027-07-09 to accommodate our internal review slot.

We can do the kickoff on 2027-06-24 as you proposed. I will invite the primary reviewer from the security team to that call.

Samira Khan
Head of IT Risk | ZenVera
samira.khan@zenvera.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenvera.com>, IT Security <security@zenvera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + SOC 2 evidence timeline — ZenVera security review

Thanks Samira — that all makes sense and good catch on the penetration test. I've updated the MAP to reflect the new evidence delivery date and the additional items you listed. Key changes attached in MAP-ZenVera-v1.3.docx:

- Evidence delivery: 2027-07-09 (Redwood delivers initial package)
- Added artifacts: background-check-policy.pdf (redacted), pen-test-attestation.pdf, log_retention_policy.pdf
- Point of contact acknowledged: Samira Khan (security@zenvera.com)

Operational notes:
- Marissa, can you own assembling the background-check policy and log retention doc? Sergio will pull the pen-test attestation and confirm last test date.
- I'll put together a secure transfer plan (sftp / SharePoint link) and send the DocuSign timeline to Procurement once signoff is in sight.

Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-Pack-V2.pdf (updated index referencing additional artifacts).

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference

Connor / Sergio — noted. I will prepare the redacted background-check-policy.pdf and the log_retention_policy.pdf by 2027-07-05 and drop them into the secure transfer folder Connor will set up.

Sergio, if you can confirm the pen-test attestation and share the filename I will add it to the package. If we need a c2c call with ZenVera security on specific artifact formats, I can join.
